title: Recipe of Drow Poison

fields.Formula: Essence of Swarming Toadstool and any Salt.
fields.Result: Coats the active weapon set for 10 turns. Throwing the crafted poison can also create a Drow Poison Cloud.
fields.Acquisition: Bookshelf in Balthazar’s chambers at Moonrise Towers, X −150, Y −169.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
